channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Mouni Roy Shares Adorable Selfie with Karisma Kapoor, Calls Her ‘My Favourite’
item.description: Actress Mouni Roy enjoyed a fangirl moment as she got the opportunity to share the stage with her 'favourite' Karisma Kapoor. Mouni took to the Stories section of her Instagram handle and posted a selfie with Karisma.

item.title: Karan Johar calls Rani Mukerji’s Mardaani ‘a proud franchise of a solid star’
item.description: Actress Rani Mukerji sat down with filmmaker and her longtime friend Karan Johar for a heart-to-heart conversation as she marked 3 decades in the Indian film industry.

item.title: US courts scrutinise immigration detention, delays
item.description: Three US federal courts have issued rulings this week questioning how immigration authorities detain noncitizens and handle immigration benefit cases, granting partial relief to Indian nationals or allowing their lawsuits to move forward.

item.title: Badlapur sexual abuse case exposes failure of school administration, state to protect children: Saamana
item.description: The editorial alleged that the incident took place at a private school in Badlapur and that when the traumatised parents informed the school principal, the management attempted to suppress the matter instead of taking immediate action.

item.title: Today women are leading progress of our nation: HM Shah on National Girl Child Day
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Saturday extended greetings to everyone on National Girl Child Day, emphasising that girls are not merely a responsibility but represent sheer strength and an invaluable force in nation-building as women are leading the progress of India now.

item.title: Awami League Says Yunus Regime Undermining Constitution Through Referendum
item.description: Bangladesh’s Awami League accused the “illegal” Muhammad Yunus-led interim government of attempting to stage a “so-called referendum”, calling it not merely a gross violation of constitutional norms but a calculated effort to mislead the people.

item.title: Kolkata Police bust fake job racket, man arrested for Rs 32 lakh fraud
item.description: Kolkata Police have busted a fake job racket and arrested a man for allegedly cheating three youths of Rs 32 lakh by promising them jobs at Indian Oil Corporation (IOC), officials said on Saturday.

item.title: B-Tech student scolded for coming back to hostel drunk ‘jumps’ from Greater Noida building
item.description: Udit returned to the hostel late at night along with his friends after allegedly consuming alcohol. The hostel authorities noticed the students' condition and reprimanded him for violating hostel rules, officials mentioned.

item.title: Six killed in suicide bombing during wedding celebrations in Pakistan’s KP
item.description: At least six people were killed, and more than a dozen others sustained injuries after a suicide bombing struck wedding celebrations in Pakistan’s Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province, local media reported on Saturday.

item.title: Amanjot, Pratika earn maiden Test call for Au’s tour, Radha Yadav to lead India A in Rising Stars Asia Cup
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced the women’s squad for the one-off Test against Australia, with several new faces joining the Indian red-ball setup, as well as the India A squad for the upcoming ACC Rising Stars Asia Cup.
